verdict.rationale: Tilled is a payments infrastructure platform (APIs, dashboard, merchant onboarding, webhooks), not an AI agent or assistant. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers to use their tools is outside this product type's role. Nothing in the evidence shows any agent or MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
